```{r}
max_percent_mt <- 20
# Limit genes to keep object size manageable.

n_pcs <- 30

jackstraw_pc_fdr_threshold <- 0.05
jackstraw_fallback_dims <- 1:10

  path.expand(working_dir),
  "data",
  "HPCA_reference.rds"
)
download_hpca_if_missing <- TRUE

# Reproducibility
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Metadata helper functions
#-------------------------------------

get_sample_id <- function(file) {
  basename(file) %>%
    str_remove("_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.*\\.h5$")
}

get_condition <- function(file) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  
  case_when(
    str_detect(filename, regex("_DD_", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "DDLPS",
    str_detect(filename, regex("_WD_", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "WDLPS",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

get_patient_id <- function(file) {
  sample_id <- get_sample_id(file)
  str_match(sample_id, "^GSM[0-9]+_([0-9]+)_")[, 2]
}

sample_metadata <- data.frame(
  file = selected_files,
  sample_id = sapply(selected_files, get_sample_id),
  condition = sapply(selected_files, get_condition),
  patient_id = sapply(selected_files, get_patient_id),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write_csv(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(tables_metadata_dir, "sample_metadata.csv")
)

sample_metadata
```

```{r}
#----------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: RNA-only reader for 10X multiome H5 files
#----------------------------------------------------

read_10x_h5_rna_only <- function(h5_file) {
  
  if (!file.exists(h5_file)) {
    stop("File does not exist: ", h5_file)
  }
  
  h5 <- H5File$new(h5_file, mode = "r")
  on.exit(h5$close_all())
  
  mat_group <- h5[["matrix"]]
  feat_group <- h5[["matrix/features"]]
  
  data <- mat_group[["data"]][]
  indices <- mat_group[["indices"]][]
  indptr <- mat_group[["indptr"]][]
  barcodes <- mat_group[["barcodes"]][]
  
  feature_type <- feat_group[["feature_type"]][]
  gene_names <- feat_group[["name"]][]
  
  rna_features <- which(feature_type == "Gene Expression")
  
  if (length(rna_features) == 0) {
    stop("No Gene Expression features found in: ", h5_file)
  }
  
  row_map <- rep(NA_integer_, length(feature_type))
  row_map[rna_features] <- seq_along(rna_features) - 1L
  
  keep <- !is.na(row_map[indices + 1L])
  
  new_i <- row_map[indices[keep] + 1L]
  new_x <- as.numeric(data[keep])
  
  n_cells <- length(barcodes)
  counts_per_col <- integer(n_cells)
  
  for (j in seq_len(n_cells)) {
    start <- indptr[j] + 1L
    end <- indptr[j + 1L]
    
    if (end >= start) {
      counts_per_col[j] <- sum(keep[start:end])
    }
  }
  
  new_p <- c(0L, cumsum(counts_per_col))
  rna_gene_names <- make.unique(gene_names[rna_features])
  
  rna_mat <- new(
    "dgCMatrix",
    i = as.integer(new_i),
    p = as.integer(new_p),
    x = new_x,
    Dim = as.integer(c(length(rna_features), n_cells)),
    Dimnames = list(rna_gene_names, barcodes)
  )
  
  return(rna_mat)
}

# Test one file
test_counts <- read_10x_h5_rna_only(selected_files[1])
dim(test_counts)
rm(test_counts)
gc()

```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Create RNA-only Seurat objects per sample
#-----------------------------------------------------

create_rna_seurat_object <- function(file) {
  
  sample_id <- get_sample_id(file)
  condition <- get_condition(file)
  patient_id <- get_patient_id(file)
  
  message("Creating Seurat object for: ", sample_id)
  
  counts <- read_10x_h5_rna_only(file)
  colnames(counts) <- paste(sample_id, colnames(counts), sep = "_")
  
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    assay = "RNA",
    project = sample_id,
    min.cells = min_cells_create,
    min.features = min_features_create
  )
  
  obj$sample_id <- sample_id
  obj$condition <- condition
  obj$patient_id <- patient_id
  
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^RP[SL]")
  
  return(obj)
}

for (file in selected_files) {
  
  sample_id <- get_sample_id(file)
  raw_path <- file.path(
    objects_raw_dir,
    paste0(sample_id, "_RNA_only_raw.rds")
  )
  
  if (!file.exists(raw_path)) {
    obj <- create_rna_seurat_object(file)
    saveRDS(obj, raw_path)
    rm(obj)
    gc()
  } else {
    message("Raw object already exists, skipping: ", sample_id)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 7: QC filtering one sample at a time
#-----------------------------------------------

sample_rds_files <- list.files(
  objects_raw_dir,
  pattern = "_RNA_only_raw\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

qc_filtering_summary <- data.frame()
qc_before_plot_list <- list()
qc_after_plot_list <- list()

sample_qc_metrics <- function(
  object,
  stage
) {
  metadata <- object[[]]

  metadata %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
    transmute(
      cell,
      sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
      condition = as.character(condition),
      stage = stage,
      nFeature_RNA,
      nCount_RNA,
      percent.mt
    )
}

for (rds_file in sample_rds_files) {
  
  message("QC filtering: ", basename(rds_file))
  
  obj <- readRDS(rds_file)
  
  sample_id <- unique(obj$sample_id)
  condition <- unique(obj$condition)
  patient_id <- unique(obj$patient_id)
  
  cells_before <- ncol(obj)
  
  nf_upper <- quantile(obj$nFeature_RNA, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
  nc_upper <- quantile(obj$nCount_RNA, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  obj_filt <- subset(
    obj,
    subset =
      nFeature_RNA >= min_features_qc &
      nFeature_RNA <= nf_upper &
      nCount_RNA <= nc_upper &
      percent.mt <= max_percent_mt
  )
  
  cells_after <- ncol(obj_filt)

  qc_before_plot_list[[sample_id]] <- sample_qc_metrics(
    obj,
    "Before filtering"
  )
  qc_after_plot_list[[sample_id]] <- sample_qc_metrics(
    obj_filt,
    "After filtering"
  )
  
  filtered_path <- file.path(
    objects_filtered_dir,
    paste0(sample_id, "_RNA_only_filtered.rds")
  )
  
  saveRDS(obj_filt, filtered_path)
  
  qc_filtering_summary <- rbind(
    qc_filtering_summary,
    data.frame(
      sample_id = sample_id,
      condition = condition,
      patient_id = patient_id,
      cells_before = cells_before,
      cells_after = cells_after,
      cells_removed = cells_before - cells_after,
      percent_removed = round(((cells_before - cells_after) / cells_before) * 100, 2),
      median_nFeature_after = median(obj_filt$nFeature_RNA),
      median_nCount_after = median(obj_filt$nCount_RNA),
      median_percent_mt_after = median(obj_filt$percent.mt)
    )
  )
  
  rm(obj, obj_filt)
  gc()
}

write_csv(
  qc_filtering_summary,
  file.path(tables_metadata_dir, "QC_filtering_summary.csv")
)

qc_before_plot_data <- bind_rows(qc_before_plot_list)
qc_after_plot_data <- bind_rows(qc_after_plot_list)

qc_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  qc_before_plot_data,
  qc_after_plot_data
)

write_csv(
  qc_plot_data,
  file.path(
    tables_metadata_dir,
    "QC_violin_all_cell_metrics.csv"
  )
)

make_qc_violin <- function(data, plot_title) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = factor(
        sample_id,
        levels = sample_metadata$sample_id
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nFeature_RNA, nCount_RNA, percent.mt),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = sample_id,
        y = value,
        fill = condition
      )
    ) +
    geom_violin(
      scale = "width",
      trim = TRUE,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.12,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ metric,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 1
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Sample",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
}

p_qc_before <- make_qc_violin(
  qc_before_plot_data,
  "RNA quality metrics before filtering"
)
p_qc_after <- make_qc_violin(
  qc_after_plot_data,
  "RNA quality metrics after filtering"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_qc_dir,
    "QC_violin_before_filtering.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_qc_before,
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_qc_dir,
    "QC_violin_after_filtering.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_qc_after,
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)

rm(
  qc_before_plot_list,
  qc_after_plot_list,
  qc_before_plot_data,
  qc_after_plot_data,
  qc_plot_data,
  p_qc_before,
  p_qc_after
)
gc()

qc_filtering_summary
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------
# STEP 8: Build full filtered-cell naive cohort
#-------------------------------------------------

filtered_rds_files <- list.files(
  objects_filtered_dir,
  pattern = "_RNA_only_filtered\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Filtered sample objects:", length(filtered_rds_files), "\n")
stopifnot(length(filtered_rds_files) == length(selected_files))

get_counts_matrix <- function(obj) {
  tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  )
}

# Common genes across samples
common_genes <- NULL

for (file in filtered_rds_files) {
  obj <- readRDS(file)
  genes <- rownames(obj)
  
  if (is.null(common_genes)) {
    common_genes <- genes
  } else {
    common_genes <- intersect(common_genes, genes)
  }
  
  rm(obj, genes)
  gc()
}

cat("Common genes:", length(common_genes), "\n")

# Use all QC-filtered cells
counts_list <- list()
metadata_list <- list()

for (file in filtered_rds_files) {
  
  obj <- readRDS(file)
  
  sample_id <- unique(obj$sample_id)
  condition <- unique(obj$condition)
  patient_id <- unique(obj$patient_id)
  
  counts <- get_counts_matrix(obj)
  counts <- counts[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Step 6 already prefixes barcodes. Add prefixes only for legacy objects without them.
  sample_prefix <- paste0(sample_id, "_")
  if (!all(startsWith(colnames(counts), sample_prefix))) {
    colnames(counts) <- paste(sample_id, colnames(counts), sep = "_")
  }
  
  md <- data.frame(
    cell = colnames(counts),
    sample_id = sample_id,
    condition = condition,
    patient_id = patient_id,
    row.names = colnames(counts)
  )
  
  counts_list[[sample_id]] <- counts
  metadata_list[[sample_id]] <- md
  
  rm(obj, counts, md)
  gc()
}

combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)
combined_metadata <- do.call(rbind, metadata_list)

rownames(combined_metadata) <- combined_metadata$cell
combined_metadata <- combined_metadata[colnames(combined_counts), ]

stopifnot(all(colnames(combined_counts) == rownames(combined_metadata)))

# Retain top expressed genes
gene_totals <- Matrix::rowSums(combined_counts)

top_genes <- names(
  sort(gene_totals, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:min(top_expressed_genes, length(gene_totals))]

combined_counts_small <- combined_counts[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Free large matrices before normalisation
rm(combined_counts, counts_list, metadata_list, gene_totals)
gc()

naive_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = combined_counts_small,
  assay = "RNA",
  project = project_name,
  meta.data = combined_metadata,
  min.cells = min_cells_create,
  min.features = 100
)

naive_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(naive_seurat, pattern = "^MT-")
naive_seurat[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(naive_seurat, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

rm(combined_counts_small, combined_metadata)
gc()

saveRDS(
  naive_seurat,
  file.path(
    objects_integrated_dir,
    "GSE324208_naive_full_filtered_counts.rds"
  )
)

print(naive_seurat)
table(naive_seurat$condition)
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 9: Naive analysis without integration
#-----------------------------------------------

naive_seurat <- NormalizeData(
  naive_seurat,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = TRUE
)

naive_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(
  naive_seurat,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = n_hvgs,
  verbose = TRUE
)

hvg_use <- VariableFeatures(naive_seurat)

naive_seurat <- ScaleData(
  naive_seurat,
  features = hvg_use,
  verbose = TRUE
)

naive_seurat <- RunPCA(
  naive_seurat,
  features = hvg_use,
  npcs = n_pcs,
  verbose = TRUE
)

p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(
  naive_seurat,
  ndims = n_pcs,
  reduction = "pca"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_clustering_dir,
    "ElbowPlot_PCA_dimensions.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_elbow,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# Use JackStraw p-values to choose PCs for downstream steps
set.seed(42)
naive_seurat <- JackStraw(
  naive_seurat,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = n_pcs,
  num.replicate = jackstraw_replicates,
  verbose = TRUE
)

naive_seurat <- ScoreJackStraw(
  naive_seurat,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
  score.thresh = jackstraw_score_threshold
)

jackstraw_results <- as.data.frame(
  JS(naive_seurat[["pca"]], slot = "overall")
) %>%
  transmute(
    pc = as.integer(PC),
    p_value = as.numeric(Score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj_BH < jackstraw_pc_fdr_threshold
  )

significant_pcs <- jackstraw_results$pc[jackstraw_results$significant]

if (length(significant_pcs) < 2L) {
  dims_use <- intersect(jackstraw_fallback_dims, seq_len(n_pcs))
  warning(
    "Fewer than two PCs met the JackStraw threshold; using fallback PCs: ",
    paste(dims_use, collapse = ", ")
  )
} else {
  dims_use <- significant_pcs
}

write_csv(
  jackstraw_results,
  file.path(tables_metadata_dir, "JackStraw_PC_significance.csv")
)

writeLines(
  paste(dims_use, collapse = ","),
  file.path(tables_metadata_dir, "PCs_used_for_downstream_analysis.txt")
)

p_jackstraw <- JackStrawPlot(
  naive_seurat,
  dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
  reduction = "pca"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_clustering_dir,
    "JackStraw_PC_significance.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_jackstraw,
  width = 12,
  height = 9
)

message(
  "PCs selected for downstream analysis: ",
  paste(dims_use, collapse = ", ")
)

naive_seurat <- FindNeighbors(
  naive_seurat,
  dims = dims_use,
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Scan clustering resolutions for clustree
naive_seurat <- FindClusters(
  naive_seurat,
  resolution = clustree_resolutions,
  verbose = TRUE
)

p_clustree_naive <- clustree(
  naive_seurat@meta.data,
  prefix = "RNA_snn_res."
) +
  ggtitle("Naive cohort clustree after JackStraw-selected PCs")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_clustering_dir,
    "Clustree_naive_resolution_scan.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_clustree_naive,
  width = 12,
  height = 9
)

write_csv(
  data.frame(resolution_tested = clustree_resolutions),
  file.path(tables_metadata_dir, "clustree_resolutions_tested.csv")
)

# Apply selected clustering resolution.
naive_seurat <- FindClusters(
  naive_seurat,
  resolution = cluster_resolution,
  verbose = TRUE
)

naive_seurat <- RunUMAP(
  naive_seurat,
  dims = dims_use,
  reduction.name = "umap",
  seed.use = 42,
```

```{r}
integrated_harmony <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("harmony", quietly = TRUE)) {

  # Correct Harmony argument names

    object = integrated_harmony,
    group.by.vars = "sample_id",
    reduction.use = "pca",
    dims.use = dims_use,
    reduction.save = "harmony"
  )

  # Harmony dimensions follow the selected PCA dimensions
  harmony_dims_use <- seq_along(dims_use)
  
  integrated_harmony <- FindNeighbors(
    integrated_harmony,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = harmony_dims_use,
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  # Repeat resolution scan on the Harmony graph
  integrated_harmony <- FindClusters(
    integrated_harmony,
    resolution = clustree_resolutions,
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  p_clustree_harmony <- clustree(
    integrated_harmony@meta.data,
    prefix = "RNA_snn_res."

    ggtitle("Harmony cohort clustree after JackStraw-selected PCs")

  )
  
  # Apply selected Harmony resolution
  integrated_harmony <- FindClusters(
    integrated_harmony,

  )
  
  integrated_harmony <- RunUMAP(
    integrated_harmony,
    reduction = "harmony",

} else {
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------
# STEP 11: Integration quality metrics
#-----------------------------------------

calculate_mixing_metric <- function(seurat_obj, group_by = "sample_id", reduction = "umap", k = 50) {
  
  if (!requireNamespace("FNN", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("FNN is not installed. Returning NA for mixing metric.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  embedding <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, reduction = reduction)
  k_use <- min(k, nrow(embedding) - 1)
  
  nn_result <- FNN::get.knn(embedding[, 1:2], k = k_use)
  
  group_labels <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[group_by]]
  
  mixing_scores <- sapply(1:nrow(nn_result$nn.index), function(i) {
    neighbors <- nn_result$nn.index[i, ]
    neighbor_groups <- group_labels[neighbors]
    props <- table(neighbor_groups) / length(neighbor_groups)
    1 / sum(props^2)
  })
  
  mean(mixing_scores)
}

methods_list <- list(
  Naive = list(obj = naive_seurat, reduction = "umap")
)

if (!is.null(integrated_harmony)) {
  methods_list$Harmony <- list(obj = integrated_harmony, reduction = "umap.harmony")
}

mixing_results <- data.frame(
  method = names(methods_list),
  mixing_score = sapply(methods_list, function(x) {
    calculate_mixing_metric(x$obj, group_by = "sample_id", reduction = x$reduction)
  }),
  n_clusters = sapply(methods_list, function(x) {
    length(unique(x$obj$seurat_clusters))
  })
)

write_csv(
  mixing_results,
  file.path(
    tables_metadata_dir,
    "integration_comparison_metrics.csv"
  )
)

mixing_results

# Choose final object
# Use Harmony if it ran successfully; otherwise use the naive full-cell object.
if (!is.null(integrated_harmony)) {
  combined <- integrated_harmony
  umap_reduction <- "umap.harmony"
  integration_method_used <- "Harmony_full_filtered_cells"
} else {
```

```{r}

#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 12: Find cluster-specific marker genes
#-----------------------------------------------

# Marker tests use the sparse RNA assay against all other cells.
cluster_ids <- sort(unique(as.character(combined$seurat_clusters)))
all_cells <- colnames(combined)
cluster_markers_list <- vector("list", length(cluster_ids))
names(cluster_markers_list) <- cluster_ids

for (i in seq_along(cluster_ids)) {
  cluster_id <- cluster_ids[[i]]
  safe_cluster_id <- str_replace_all(cluster_id, "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_")
  cluster_marker_file <- file.path(
    tables_markers_by_cluster_dir,
    paste0("cluster_", safe_cluster_id, "_markers.csv")
  )

  if (reuse_completed_cluster_markers && file.exists(cluster_marker_file)) {
    message("Reusing marker table for cluster ", cluster_id)
    cluster_markers_list[[i]] <- read_csv(
      cluster_marker_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
    next
  }

  message(
    "Finding markers for cluster ",
    cluster_id,
    " (",
    i,
    "/",
    length(cluster_ids),
    ")"
  )

  target_pool <- all_cells[
    as.character(combined$seurat_clusters) == cluster_id
  ]
  background_pool <- setdiff(all_cells, target_pool)

  target_cells <- target_pool
  background_cells <- background_pool

  if (length(target_cells) < 3 || length(background_cells) < 3) {
    warning("Skipping cluster ", cluster_id, ": too few cells.")
    next
  }

  markers_i <- FindMarkers(
    object = combined[["RNA"]],
    cells.1 = target_cells,
    cells.2 = background_cells,
    only.pos = TRUE,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(markers_i) > 0) {
    markers_i <- markers_i %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      mutate(
        cluster = cluster_id,
        n_target_tested = length(target_cells),
        n_background_tested = length(background_cells)
      ) %>%
      filter(!grepl("^RP[SL]", gene)) %>%
      filter(!grepl("^MT-", gene))

    write_csv(markers_i, cluster_marker_file)
    cluster_markers_list[[i]] <- markers_i
  } else {
    warning("No positive marker genes found for cluster ", cluster_id)
  }

  rm(
    target_pool,
    background_pool,
    target_cells,
    background_cells,
    markers_i
  )
  gc()
}

cluster_markers_filtered <- bind_rows(cluster_markers_list)

if (nrow(cluster_markers_filtered) == 0) {
  stop("No cluster marker tables were produced.")
}

fold_change_column <- intersect(
  c("avg_log2FC", "avg_logFC"),
  colnames(cluster_markers_filtered)
)[1]

if (is.na(fold_change_column)) {
  stop("No average log-fold-change column found in marker results.")
}

top5_markers <- cluster_markers_filtered %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = .data[[fold_change_column]],
    n = 5,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(.data[[fold_change_column]]))

write_csv(
  cluster_markers_filtered,
  file.path(tables_markers_dir, "cluster_markers_all_filtered.csv")
)

write_csv(
  top5_markers,
  file.path(tables_markers_dir, "top5_markers_per_cluster.csv")

# Cluster-average heatmap
heatmap_genes <- unique(top5_markers$gene)
heatmap_genes <- heatmap_genes[heatmap_genes %in% rownames(combined)]

log_data_heatmap <- tryCatch(
  GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
  error = function(e) GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
)

cluster_factor_heatmap <- factor(
  as.character(combined$seurat_clusters),
  levels = cluster_ids
)

cluster_membership_heatmap <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + cluster_factor_heatmap
)
colnames(cluster_membership_heatmap) <- cluster_ids

cluster_sizes_heatmap <- Matrix::colSums(cluster_membership_heatmap)
cluster_sums_heatmap <- log_data_heatmap[
  heatmap_genes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
] %*% cluster_membership_heatmap

cluster_means_heatmap <- sweep(
  as.matrix(cluster_sums_heatmap),

cluster_z_heatmap <- t(scale(t(cluster_means_heatmap)))
cluster_z_heatmap[!is.finite(cluster_z_heatmap)] <- 0

heatmap_plot_data <- as.data.frame(

    x = "Seurat cluster",
```

```{r}
get_marker_set <- function(marker_df, marker_columns, object = NULL) {
  
  genes <- marker_df %>%
    select(any_of(marker_columns)) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    as.character()
  
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  genes <- unique(genes)
  
  if (!is.null(object)) {
    genes <- genes[genes %in% rownames(object)]
  }
  
  return(genes)
}
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 15B: Independent SingleR annotation with HPCA
#-------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("hpca_reference_file")) {
  hpca_reference_file <- file.path(
    getwd(),
    "data",
    "HPCA_reference.rds"
  )
}
if (!exists("download_hpca_if_missing")) {
  download_hpca_if_missing <- TRUE
}

combined$SingleR_HPCA_label <- NA_character_
combined$SingleR_HPCA_pruned <- NA_character_
combined$SingleR_HPCA_final <- NA_character_

hpca_cluster_labels <- data.frame(
  seurat_clusters = sort(unique(as.character(combined$seurat_clusters))),
  SingleR_HPCA_label = NA_character_,
  SingleR_HPCA_fraction = NA_real_
)

if (
  !file.exists(hpca_reference_file) &&
  download_hpca_if_missing &&
  requireNamespace("celldex", quietly = TRUE)
) {
  message(
    "HPCA reference not found; downloading it through celldex and caching: ",
    hpca_reference_file
  )
  dir.create(
    dirname(hpca_reference_file),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  hpca_download <- tryCatch(
    celldex::HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData(),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Unable to download HPCA reference: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(hpca_download)) {
    saveRDS(hpca_download, hpca_reference_file)
    rm(hpca_download)
    gc()
  }
}

if (file.exists(hpca_reference_file)) {
  ref <- readRDS(hpca_reference_file)

  if (!inherits(ref, "SummarizedExperiment")) {
    stop("HPCA_reference.rds must contain a SummarizedExperiment-like object.")
  }
  if (!"label.main" %in% colnames(colData(ref))) {
    stop("HPCA reference does not contain ref$label.main.")
  }

  # SingleR accepts a log-normalised gene-by-cell matrix as the test input.
  mtx <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
  )

  common_hpca_genes <- intersect(rownames(mtx), rownames(ref))
  if (length(common_hpca_genes) < 1000) {
    warning("Fewer than 1,000 genes overlap the query and HPCA reference.")
  }

  pred <- SingleR(
    test = mtx[common_hpca_genes, , drop = FALSE],
    ref = ref[common_hpca_genes, ],
    labels = ref$label.main
  )

  pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred)
  pred_df$cell <- rownames(pred_df)
  pred_df$seurat_clusters <- as.character(
    combined$seurat_clusters[match(pred_df$cell, colnames(combined))]
  )
  pred_df$SingleR_HPCA_final <- ifelse(
    is.na(pred_df$pruned.labels),
    "Uncertain",
    pred_df$pruned.labels
  )

  pred_match <- match(colnames(combined), pred_df$cell)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(pred_match))
  combined$SingleR_HPCA_label <- pred_df$labels[pred_match]
  combined$SingleR_HPCA_pruned <- pred_df$pruned.labels[pred_match]
  combined$SingleR_HPCA_final <- pred_df$SingleR_HPCA_final[pred_match]

  write_csv(
    pred_df %>%
      select(
        cell,
        seurat_clusters,
        labels,
        pruned.labels,
        delta.next,
        SingleR_HPCA_final
      ),
    file.path(
      tables_annotations_dir,
      "SingleR_HPCA_cell_predictions.csv"
    )
  )

  hpca_cluster_labels <- pred_df %>%
    count(seurat_clusters, SingleR_HPCA_final, name = "n_cells") %>%
    group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
    mutate(SingleR_HPCA_fraction = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) %>%
    arrange(seurat_clusters, desc(n_cells)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(SingleR_HPCA_label = SingleR_HPCA_final)

  write_csv(
    hpca_cluster_labels,
    file.path(
      tables_annotations_dir,
      "SingleR_HPCA_cluster_majority_labels.csv"
    )
  )

  p_singler_hpca <- DimPlot(
    combined,
    reduction = umap_reduction,
    group.by = "SingleR_HPCA_final",
    label = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE,
    pt.size = 0.5
  ) +
    ggtitle("WDLPS-only cohort SingleR: HPCA Reference")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      plots_annotation_dir,
      "UMAP_SingleR_HPCA.pdf"
    ),
    plot = p_singler_hpca,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )

  rm(ref, mtx, pred, pred_df)
  gc()
} else {
  warning(
    "HPCA reference not found at ",
    hpca_reference_file,
    ". Install celldex with BiocManager::install('celldex'), ",
    "then rerun Step 15B. Skipping HPCA SingleR."
  )
}
```

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 16: ScType scoring using exact marker columns
#---------------------------------------------------------

# Remove incomplete scoring columns from failed runs.
stale_score_columns <- grep(
  "_Score[0-9]+$",
  colnames(combined@meta.data),
  value = TRUE
)
if (length(stale_score_columns) > 0) {
  combined@meta.data <- combined@meta.data[
    ,
    setdiff(colnames(combined@meta.data), stale_score_columns),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  gc()
}

# ScType-style scoring uses cluster-level marker z-scores
log_data_sctype <- tryCatch(
  GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
  error = function(e) GetAssayData(combined, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
)

cluster_levels_sctype <- sort(
  unique(as.character(combined$seurat_clusters))
)
cluster_index_sctype <- match(
  as.character(combined$seurat_clusters),
  cluster_levels_sctype
)

cluster_membership_sctype <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = seq_len(ncol(combined)),
  j = cluster_index_sctype,
  x = 1,
  dims = c(ncol(combined), length(cluster_levels_sctype)),
  dimnames = list(colnames(combined), cluster_levels_sctype)
)

cluster_sizes_sctype <- Matrix::colSums(cluster_membership_sctype)
cluster_sums_sctype <- log_data_sctype %*% cluster_membership_sctype
cluster_means_sctype <- as.matrix(cluster_sums_sctype)
cluster_means_sctype <- sweep(
  cluster_means_sctype,
  2,
  cluster_sizes_sctype,
  "/"
)

gene_centres_sctype <- rowMeans(cluster_means_sctype)
gene_sds_sctype <- apply(cluster_means_sctype, 1, stats::sd)
gene_sds_sctype[
  !is.finite(gene_sds_sctype) | gene_sds_sctype == 0
] <- 1

cluster_z_sctype <- sweep(
  cluster_means_sctype,
  1,
  gene_centres_sctype,
  "-"
)
cluster_z_sctype <- sweep(
  cluster_z_sctype,
  1,
  gene_sds_sctype,
  "/"
)
cluster_z_sctype[!is.finite(cluster_z_sctype)] <- 0

sctype_score_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(marker_panel_exact_use),
  ncol = length(cluster_levels_sctype),
  dimnames = list(
    names(marker_panel_exact_use),
    cluster_levels_sctype
  )
)

markers_used_sctype <- integer(length(marker_panel_exact_use))
names(markers_used_sctype) <- names(marker_panel_exact_use)

for (marker_col in names(marker_panel_exact_use)) {
  genes <- intersect(
    marker_panel_exact_use[[marker_col]],
    rownames(cluster_z_sctype)
  )
  markers_used_sctype[[marker_col]] <- length(genes)

  if (length(genes) >= 2) {
    sctype_score_matrix[marker_col, ] <- colMeans(
      cluster_z_sctype[genes, , drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
}

score_by_cluster_exact_long <- as.data.frame(
  t(sctype_score_matrix),
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("seurat_clusters") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -seurat_clusters,
    names_to = "marker_column",
    values_to = "mean_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_markers_used = unname(markers_used_sctype[marker_column])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_score))

sctype_exact_cluster_labels <- score_by_cluster_exact_long %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    ScType_exact_marker_column = marker_column,
    ScType_exact_score = mean_score
  )

write_csv(
  score_by_cluster_exact_long,
  file.path(
    tables_annotations_dir,
    "ScType_style_exact_marker_column_scores_long.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  sctype_exact_cluster_labels,
  file.path(
    tables_annotations_dir,
    "ScType_style_exact_marker_column_cluster_labels.csv"
  )
)

sctype_exact_label_map <- setNames(
  sctype_exact_cluster_labels$ScType_exact_marker_column,
  sctype_exact_cluster_labels$seurat_clusters
)

combined$ScType_exact_marker_column <- unname(
  sctype_exact_label_map[as.character(combined$seurat_clusters)]
)

rm(
  log_data_sctype,
  cluster_membership_sctype,
  cluster_sums_sctype,
  cluster_means_sctype,
  cluster_z_sctype,
  gene_centres_sctype,
  gene_sds_sctype,
  sctype_score_matrix
)
gc()

p_sctype_exact <- DimPlot(
  combined,
  reduction = umap_reduction,
  group.by = "ScType_exact_marker_column",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggtitle("WDLPS-only cohort ScType: Marker-Based Annotation")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_annotation_dir,
    "UMAP_ScType_exact_marker_columns.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_sctype_exact,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# Checkpoint after the annotation methods.
saveRDS(
  combined,
  file.path(
    objects_final_dir,
    "GSE324208_after_HPCA_ScType_annotation.rds"
  )
)
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------

# Compare Manual -> SingleR and Manual -> ScType

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(readr)

# One comparison record per Seurat cluster
cluster_sizes_for_comparison <- combined@meta.data %>%
  transmute(
    seurat_clusters = as.character(seurat_clusters)
  ) %>%
  count(seurat_clusters, name = "n_cells")

cluster_annotation_comparison_plot <- cluster_sizes_for_comparison %>%
  left_join(
    manual_annotation_table %>%
      transmute(
        seurat_clusters = as.character(seurat_clusters),
        Manual_annotation = as.character(manual_annotation)
      ),
    by = "seurat_clusters"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hpca_cluster_labels %>%
      transmute(
        seurat_clusters = as.character(seurat_clusters),

      ),
    by = "seurat_clusters"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sctype_exact_cluster_labels %>%
      transmute(
        seurat_clusters = as.character(seurat_clusters),
        ScType_annotation = as.character(ScType_exact_marker_column)
      ),
    by = "seurat_clusters"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Manual_annotation = ifelse(
      is.na(Manual_annotation) | Manual_annotation == "",
      "Unresolved",
      Manual_annotation
    ),
    SingleR_annotation = ifelse(
      is.na(SingleR_annotation) | SingleR_annotation == "",
      "Unavailable",
      SingleR_annotation
    ),
    ScType_annotation = ifelse(
      is.na(ScType_annotation) | ScType_annotation == "",
      "Unresolved",
      ScType_annotation
    ),
    Manual_annotation_plot = str_wrap(
      str_replace_all(Manual_annotation, "_", " "),
      width = 22
    ),
    SingleR_annotation_plot = str_wrap(
      str_replace_all(SingleR_annotation, "_", " "),
      width = 22
    ),
    ScType_annotation_plot = str_wrap(
      str_replace_all(ScType_annotation, "_", " "),
      width = 22
    )
  )
write_csv(
  cluster_annotation_comparison_plot,

    tables_annotations_dir,
    "cluster_level_annotation_comparison_for_pairwise_sankey.csv"
  )
)
manual_singler_flow <- cluster_annotation_comparison_plot %>%

 summarise(n_cells = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop")

make_pairwise_sankey <- function(
  flow_data,
  right_column,
  right_axis_title,
  plot_title
) {
  manual_order <- flow_data %>%
    group_by(Manual_annotation_plot) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    pull(Manual_annotation_plot)
  
  right_order <- flow_data %>%
    group_by(.data[[right_column]]) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total))
  right_order <- right_order[[right_column]]
  
  flow_data$Manual_annotation_plot <- factor(
    flow_data$Manual_annotation_plot,
    levels = manual_order
  )
  flow_data[[right_column]] <- factor(
    flow_data[[right_column]],
    levels = right_order
  )
ggplot(
    flow_data,
    aes(
      axis1 = Manual_annotation_plot,
      axis2 = .data[[right_column]],
      y = n_cells
    )
  ) +
 geom_alluvium(
      aes(fill = Manual_annotation_plot),
      width = 0.18,
      alpha = 0.6,
      knot.pos = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_stratum(
      width = 0.22,
      fill = "white",
      colour = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_text(
      stat = "stratum",
      aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
      size = 2.7,
      lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c("Manual", right_axis_title),
      expand = c(0.14, 0.14)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of cells"
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

p_manual_singler_sankey <- make_pairwise_sankey(
  manual_singler_flow,
  right_column = "SingleR_annotation_plot",
  right_axis_title = "SingleR",
  plot_title = "Manual vs SingleR"
)

p_manual_sctype_sankey <- make_pairwise_sankey(
  manual_sctype_flow,
  right_column = "ScType_annotation_plot",
  right_axis_title = "ScType",
  plot_title = "Manual vs ScType"
)

p_pairwise_annotation_sankey <- (
  p_manual_singler_sankey | p_manual_sctype_sankey
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Pairwise annotation comparison: WDLPS-only cohort",
    subtitle = paste(
      "One flow per cluster label pair; widths are weighted by cluster cell",
      "counts."
    )
  )

  ),
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 18: Manually annotated cell-state proportions by sample
#-----------------------------------------------------------------

sample_keys <- combined@meta.data %>%
  distinct(sample_id, condition, patient_id)

annotation_levels <- sort(
  unique(as.character(combined$manual_annotation))
)

# Add zero-count sample/state combinations before proportions
cell_state_props <- combined@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_id, condition, manual_annotation, name = "n_cells") %>%
  left_join(sample_keys, by = c("sample_id", "condition")) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(sample_id, condition, patient_id),
    manual_annotation = annotation_levels,
    fill = list(n_cells = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  cell_state_props,
  file.path(
    tables_annotations_dir,
    "cell_state_proportions_by_sample.csv"
  )
)

p_state_props <- ggplot(
  cell_state_props,
  aes(x = manual_annotation, y = prop, fill = manual_annotation)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Manual cell annotations in WDLPS-only cohort",
    subtitle = "Each point is one sample",
    x = "Manual annotation",
    y = "Proportion per sample"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_final_dir,
    "Manual_annotation_proportions_WDLPS_only.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_state_props,
  width = 14,
  height = 9
)
```
